sections.title: Morning Shift (06:30 – 14:45)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at the office. Debriefing with night shift and then gearing up to go and patrol.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square. Whilst patrolling we will be conducting welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks, Queen St McDonald's all clear. Localito and 77 Convenience Stores have just opened. Continuing to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing a sweep of the area.
Heading towards Federal St via Wellesley St.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St. Welfare checks completed from Eighty Fed, Coffee Club, both 77 Convenience Stores, and News Agency store. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Wyndham St via Federal St.
Standing by at the corner of Wyndham and Albert St. Welfare check on Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart all clear. Continuing towards Lower Albert.
Arrived at Lower Albert, on standby at Commercial Bay for security presence.
McDonald's Britomart all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Raining weather, will be seeking shelter whenever possible. Heading towards Gore St.
Arrived at Gore St. Completed welfare checks on Coffee Club, Custom Mart, and 77 Convenience Store. Checking on businesses on Gore St.
Welfare check on SO/ Hotel, Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, and Chargrill all clear. Standing by for security presence.

Welfare check on Vapor Kings, Vape Haven, Right Track, KFC, Fort Lane, Wilson Carpark, 77 Convenience Store, Pocket Park and Fort St all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via Shortland St and High St.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Half of High St all clear from Hotel Debrett to Freyburg Square. No issues to report. Chancery is clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Lorne St via High St.
High St and Lorne St all clear. Heading to check on Library area.
Library area all clear. Standing by for security presence and seeking shelter from rain.
Heading to check in near Nandos and Munster Inn.
All clear. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square all clear, standing by for shelter.
Received a call from Victoria St 77 Convenience Store requesting assistance with removing vagrants due to smoking weed and drinking alcohol.
We arrived at 77 Convenience Store and removed one male for drinking in public. Standing by for security presence.
Heading back on patrol. We also received a call from Cosmetic Clinic about a female vagrant that may be mentally unstable. Heading there now.

We arrived and spoke to the workers; they stated the female makes people and customers feel uncomfortable. She's been making gagging sounds like she's vomiting. After we were able to make her move along, we spoke to the staff to let them know we will be standing by for security presence.
Received a call about 2 vagrants outside the stores who 'might be' asking for food or money. Heading to the location now.
Received a call from Cotton On about a potential thief in their store. We will respond to Cotton On first as a higher priority.

We spoke to the workers and they said the POI is in the dressing room. We waited for about 30 mins and then when we checked her bag she was calm until we asked to check her jacket and she became uncooperative. We let her go after confirming no clothing was taken, and then when she left one team member assumes she may have taken some jewelry items. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check in on McDonald's Queen St.
All clear. The workers said that 2 people outside looked like they were begging for money but were not sure. Standing by for security presence.
Heading back to the office to have break.
We received a call from Starbucks requesting assistance with removing a vagrant sleeping in the store. Heading to location now.
All clear, we removed the POI. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to office to stand by for security presence and charge the Ops phone.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (15:00 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing welfare patrol on Queen Street, heading down. (Note: due to weather conditions patrols will be limited to sheltered areas unless urgent assistance is needed.)
Full sweep on lower Queen St, Vulcan Lane, Shortland St complete, no issues nor any concerning activity to report in the areas checked. Heading over to Commercial Bay.

Welfare check on Commercial Bay McDonald's, no issues to report. Visual report on Commercial Bay clear, no issues to report. Heading back up Queen St (reminder: due to the rain will be standing by sheltered areas).
Welfare sweep on Upper Queen St, Lorne St, visual check on Darby complete, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence, will make our way up to Victoria St.
Victoria St welfare sweep complete, no problematic issues found to report. Heading back onto Queen St to maintain security presence and also standby for response calls as none have come through.
Standing by sheltered areas but also maintaining security presence.
Patrol on Albert Street complete, no issues to report. Weather is not calming down, will continue patrol under sheltered areas.
Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
Standing by HQ for response calls whilst phone is charging.
No calls to report nor any issues to report. Ops phone charged to a sufficient battery percentage, commencing security maintaining on Queen St. Then heading to office to standby for shift changeover.
Guard has arrived only to find out guard has to cover another shift; will standby for cover guard.
Received a call from McDonald's Britomart about juveniles vaping and being a nuisance to staff.
Manager is heading over to call with me.
We arrived and were able to get the juveniles out; we had 5 girls and 3 boys, all seem to be under the age of 16 y/o. Standing by for security presence.
We are heading back to office for second guard.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standby in the office charging ops phone due to low percentage (7%).
Commencing patrol down Queen Street whilst welfare checking stores.
Welfare check on Wyndham Street, all clear.
Continuing patrol down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay.
Standby Commercial Bay showing our presence.
Welfare check on Britomart McDonald's, all clear, no further issues.
Full sweep Britomart, no issues identified.
Welfare check on Kemuri and Reign and Pour, all clear, no further issues. Commencing sweep on Quay Street.
Full sweep Quay Street, welfare check on Danny's, Rosie's, The Fox and Parasol and Swing.
Patrolling up Albert Street. Welfare check on lower Albert Street, all clear.
Full sweep Albert Street. Welfare check Albert Mart, all clear.
Welfare check Mayoral Drive, all clear. Arriving at Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square, not much footwork in the area. Patrolling down Lorne St.
Welfare check Lorne staircase mural and Red Radisson, all clear, no issues.
Whole of Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Whole of Lorne St all clear. Patrolling down to Fort Lane.
Arrived at Sapphires Night Club, maintaining our presence for any issues identified.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down TK Square.
Arrived Britomart, maintaining our presence due to heavy public presence in the area.
Removed alcohol from female individual drinking in public.
Seen heavy presence of gang affiliation in the area causing a disturbance, standing by in case of brawl.
Standing down from Britomart, welfare check McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear, no issues to report. Arrived at Bar101, standing by till closing.
Welfare check Bar101, all clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrols.
Sweep Darby St / Elliot St, all clear, no further issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Sweeped Victoria Street West, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no further issues.
Full sweep Federal St, check in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, Liston House, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge ops work phone.
Arrived at Headquarters, charging ops phone for a little then heading out to patrols.
Received a response call from Bar101 regarding a brawl outside their club after closing hours. On route to location.
Arrived at response location Bar101; staff notified us there were 2 individuals badly injured and taking shelter inside the premises. Going inside and welfare checking.

2 of the male individuals involved in the brawl were badly injured on the scene. Insisted I called emergency services but they quickly denied and refused services, saying they would call an Uber driver to drop them off. Standing by with them till Uber (photo/video on file).
Uber has arrived at location, escorting and maintaining presence till they leave.
2 male individuals have left the scene. Heading back to Headquarters to commence 30 minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters, commencing 30 minute break and responding to calls that occur.
Arrived at McDonald's Queens, maintaining our presence here till guard handover.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens, heading back to Headquarters till guard handover.
Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Charging ops work phone, standing by in office responding to any calls that occur.
Commencing patrols on upper Queen Street.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens and all other businesses open in the area, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling up Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep in the area and maintaining our presence for any issues identified.
Removed alcohol from a group of male individuals drinking in public, all clear.
Guided member of the public directions to the nearest fast food business open.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report in the area. Continuing patrols down Lorne St.
Welfare check Lorne Street, staircase mural centre and remaining businesses open, all clear.
Arrived at Freyburg Pl, commencing sweep in the area and maintaining presence.
Full sweep Freyburg Pl, Chancery Square, welfare check on all businesses, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check on Vulcan Lane and businesses, all clear.
Welfare check High Street and all businesses open, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Shortland Mart, all clear. Patrolling Fort Lane.
Welfare check KFC, Evan Kebabs, The Right Track, Jo&Joes, all clear.
Arrived at Sapphire Night Club, maintaining our presence here for any issues that occur.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Fort St.
Welfare check Gore St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Fort St and businesses open, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Customs Street.
Welfare check Customs Convenience Store, all clear. Arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart due to heavy footwork in the area, will be showing our presence here.
Removed alcohol from male and female individual drinking in public.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart and staff, all clear, no issues.
Standing down from Britomart, continuing patrols down.
Welfare check Reign n Pour and Kemuri guards, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Quay Street, commencing sweep in the area.
Full sweep Quay Street, welfare check Danny Doolans, Rosie's, The Fox, Parasol and Swing, Sweatshop and Lulas, Viaduct, all clear, no issues.
Top half Customs Street all clear. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check Albert Mart, all clear.
Whole of Albert Street all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Mayoral Drive, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Aotea due to not much footwork in the area, will just be walking in the area, no sweep needed.
Welfare check Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Arrived at McDonald's Queens, standing showing face in the area.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens Street. Patrolling down Bar101.
Arrived at Bar101, standing by till closing hours and making sure no problems occur.
Welfare check Bar101 till closing, all clear, waiting for public to head home due to recent incident that happened recently.
Darby St / Elliot St all clear, no further issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Victoria Street West, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no further issues.
Full sweep Federal St, check in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, Liston House, all clear.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear, no issues. Heading down Queen Street to Britomart.
Welfare check Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Completed check Fort St / Fort Lane, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up High Street to Freyburg for full sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear.
Lorne St / Wakefield all clear, no issues. Heading back to Headquarters to commence 30 minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters, commencing 30 minute break and responding to any calls that occur.
Night shift concluded, handing over to morning shift.
